contradiction_resolution: No claim-level contradiction: contradicts_claim_ids is empty and the statement opposes none of CONJ-0001, THM-0001-THM-0007, OBS-0001, or RED-0001. Primary verification of the surviving core. (1) SRC-0001 (Payne, arXiv:2605.20453v1) section 5 records verbatim that 'The prediction that H^k(Mbar_{g,n}) is pure Tate for even k <= 20 is confirmed for k <= 14, but the cases 16, 18, and 20 remain open', confirming OBS-0001 and hence that any Q(-13) assertion at the (6,6) open input is CONJ-0001, not a theorem. (2) The implication actually available in the corpus runs one way only: SRC-0002 (Canning-Larson-Payne, arXiv:2307.08830v3) Lemma 4.3 states that if X is smooth and has the CKgP then W_k H^k(X) is algebraic, i.e. algebraicity implies Tate type, never the converse. The converse is the Hodge conjecture: SRC-0001 section 2.1 states the rational cycle class map cyc^k: Z^k(X) tensor Q -> H^{2k}(X) intersect H^{k,k}(X) is (conjecturally) surjective, and section 3.1 records that tautological generation of H^{2k}(Mbar_{g,n}) is what yields the Hodge conjecture in codimension k. (3) The algebraicity input is genuinely unavailable at (6,6): THM-0005 gives c(6)=5 < 6, so M_{6,6} lies outside published CKgP coverage (spot-checked against SRC-0002, which cites M_{3,n} CKgP for n <= 11 and proves M_{7,n} CKgP for n <= 3, matching c(3)=11 and c(7)=3). The surviving core of FND-0049 -- that a degree-26 class need not be an algebraic codimension-13 cycle, so concluding type Q(-13) without controlling h^{p,26-p} for p != 13 upgrades a prediction to a theorem -- is therefore correct and non-vacuous. Two clauses do NOT survive audit. (a) 'Equating ordinary degree 26 with Chow codimension 13' is not itself an error: the cycle class map CH^13 -> H^{26} doubles degree, so 26 <-> 13 is the standard and correct dictionary, and RED-0001's arithmetic is internally consistent (d = 3g-3+n = 21, ordinary degree 2d-16 = 26 = 2(d-8), codimension d-8 = 13). RED-0001 states the type as expected under CONJ-0001, not as proved; only the converse inference is defective, not the equation. (b) 'Non-algebraic (13,13) phenomena beyond MHS type' is off-target for this campaign. A polarizable pure weight-26 Q-Hodge structure concentrated in bidegree (13,13) is by definition of Tate type and is isomorphic to Q(-13)^{sum m}, so no '(13,13) but non-Tate' Q-HS exists (consistent with corroborated FND-0033 on semisimplicity of polarizable pure Q-HS of fixed weight). What can fail for such classes is algebraicity, i.e. the open Hodge conjecture -- but the packet's exact theorem asks only that W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q) be a direct sum of Q(8), a Hodge/Galois-type statement strictly weaker than algebraicity. Requiring control of non-algebraic (13,13) classes imposes a condition the target does not have; this is the converse of the method boundary already recorded (and retired) as FND-0012. Merge determination: after excising (a) and (b), the residue is exactly corroborated FND-0048, same campaign, same case (6,6), same corner: FND-0048 states that W_26 H^26(M_{6,6};Q) = im(H^{26}(Mbar_{6,6};Q) -> H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)) is not identified by any supplied argument with a codimension-13 decorated stable-graph complex generated by algebraic cotangent and gluing classes, and that this 'does not rule out surviving non-Tate pure weight-26 summands' -- which is precisely FND-0049's surviving 'without controlling Hodge numbers h^{p,26-p} for p != 13'. The objects coincide as well: FND-0048 explicitly spans both H^{26}(Mbar_{6,6}) and its image, and by the SRC-0002 right-exact sequence H^{k-2}(boundary) -> H^k(Mbar_{g,n}) -> W_k H^k(M_{g,n}) -> 0 together with semisimplicity of the pure weight-26 category (FND-0033), Tate type of H^{26}(Mbar_{6,6}) would descend to the quotient, so failure of the algebraicity input is one obstruction at one corner, not two. Merge into FND-0048, carrying forward FND-0049's more general framing (the defect is the degree-to-algebraicity inference, not only the graph-complex route) as a scope note on the merge target. Distinguished from neighbours: retired FND-0021 and FND-0028 alleged the reverse-direction gap (that algebraicity does not obviously give Hodge-Tate, refuted by SRC-0002 Lemma 4.3) and mis-scoped CKgP against THM-0005; FND-0049 states the correct direction, so it is merged for redundancy, not retired for error. Distinct from FND-0031 (depth-zero weight-SS corner), FND-0032 (CGP top-weight mismatch), FND-0033 (semisimplicity), FND-0034 (nonseparating divisor Mbar_{5,8}). Evidence class upgraded adversarial_review -> primary_source. Audit limitations, stated rather than papered over: ATT-0020 and REV-0025 are absent from the read-only workspace, so the attempt-level attribution ('upgrades ... to an unconditional theorem') was not re-audited and the adjudication does not rest on it; proof/findings.jsonl in this workspace terminates at FND-0034, so FND-0035 through FND-0048 were read from the adjudicated-findings list of packet C66-001-v4 (sha256 f48fe2bfa1d4ea1d28ad456875551a2c9bb762d916e258953b13c7c05bdfb5f7); the four optional Grok 4.5 helper workers were deliberately not dispatched because the campaign lists 'grok' in excluded_engines and FND-0049's originating reviewer_engines is ['grok'], so an independent audit must not re-use that engine family; and content_sha256 is recorded as null for all three source records because this read-only workspace exposes no shell or hashing capability -- the digests were not computed and have not been fabricated.
